ValidationRule.description: QAC- If the Authority number is generated it cannot be denied.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Name == 'Service Request', AND( NOT(ISNULL(Authority_Number_F__c )), NOT(ISBLANK(Authority_Number_F__c ))) , OR(ISPICKVAL ( PRIORVALUE ( Authority_Status__c ), "Approved"),ISPICKVAL ( PRIORVALUE ( Authority_Status__c ), "Auto Approved")),ISCHANGED( Authority_Status__c ), OR(ISPICKVAL( Authority_Status__c , 'Denied'),ISPICKVAL( Authority_Status__c , 'Not Applicable'),ISPICKVAL( Authority_Status__c , '')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Authority Status cannot be modified after its ‘Approved’ or ‘Auto Approved’
